decisions.reason: As a flagship product line close to the core software and the firm's digitalisation path, it remains strategically valuable and inexpensive enough to keep while its longer-run contribution continues to unfold.

The education institute is less central than the software core but fits the customer base and support capabilities, so we keep it as a complementary relationship-building offer with some pruning risk if demand stays limited.
The analytics dashboard builds directly on the core practice software and the trend toward more data-driven practice management, so it is a plausible option to retain rather than abandon.
The complete practice bundle is very close to the established offer and likely low-cost to maintain as a packaging and sales vehicle, which argues for keeping it open.

The job and practice listing portal is comparatively distant from the firm's core capabilities and after several years should have revealed enough about its weak strategic fit to justify redeploying resources elsewhere.
